pages.title: Dinosaur Coloring Book Prompts for Kids & KDP
pages.metaDescription: Dinosaur coloring book prompts for five full 40-page books: baby dinos for toddlers, dino jobs, a fossil dig, prehistoric eras and adult patterns.
pages.intro: Dinosaurs are one of the steadiest sellers in kids' coloring on Amazon KDP and Etsy, because every generation of children goes through a dinosaur phase. These dinosaur coloring book prompts each make a full 40-page book: baby dinosaurs at home for toddlers, dinosaurs with jobs and sports, a fossil dig and museum trip, a realistic prehistoric world by era, and intricate patterned dinosaurs for adults. They are five different books you could list side by side.
tips: Keep the toddler book about one big dinosaur doing one familiar thing per page; parents of 2-5 year olds buy recognisable routines, not roaring predators.
Mix famous species (T-rex, triceratops, stegosaurus) with lesser-known ones like therizinosaurus and pachycephalosaurus so the Look Inside preview shows real variety.
The fossil-dig and museum angle pairs well with museum gift shops and school trips, so list it with paleontology keywords as well as dinosaur ones.

pages.title: Bible Story Coloring Book Prompts for Kids & Adults
pages.metaDescription: Five 40-page Bible story coloring book prompts: animals of the Bible, Old Testament stories, the life of Jesus, 40 parables and scripture scenes.
pages.intro: Bible story coloring books are a steady seller for Christian parents, Sunday school teachers, church groups and homeschoolers, with peaks at Easter and Christmas. Each of these five Bible story coloring book prompts makes a full 40-page book with every scene listed: animals of the Bible for toddlers, Old Testament stories in order, the life of Jesus, forty parables Jesus told, and detailed scripture-inspired scenes for adult colorists. All draw on public-domain stories.
tips: Name the exact moment (Zacchaeus up the sycamore tree, the walls of Jericho falling) so each page is recognisable.
For children's books choose the moment before the danger: David with his sling facing Goliath, Daniel among the lions.
Sunday school teachers buy books that follow the Bible's order, so one Old Testament book and one life-of-Jesus book can run a whole year.
